architectural_units.name: Security Service
architectural_units.description: Security Service (Traefik) functions as a reverse proxy and load balancer, managing HTTP and HTTPS request routing.

architectural_units.name: System Service
architectural_units.description: System Service (Next.js) serves the web application and interacts with the database and external services.

architectural_units.name: Data Service
architectural_units.description: Data Service (PostgreSQL) provides the relational database for storing application data.

architectural_units.name: Traefik
architectural_units.description: Traefik is a modern reverse proxy and load balancer designed to manage incoming and outgoing HTTP and HTTPS traffic.

architectural_units.name: Next.js
architectural_units.description: Next.js is a framework for building web applications that supports both client-side and server-side rendering.

architectural_units.name: PostgreSQL
architectural_units.description: PostgreSQL is the relational database management system used for the application.

architectural_units.name: Docker
architectural_units.description: Docker is a containerization platform used to manage the execution of the application services.

architectural_units.name: Prisma
architectural_units.description: Prisma is an ORM used to manage database queries and modifications.

architectural_units.name: Authentication Service
architectural_units.description: External service used for user authentication via Google.

architectural_units.name: Google
architectural_units.description: Google is used as the external provider for user authentication.

architectural_units.name: Cloud Storage Service
architectural_units.description: External service used for storing and retrieving files.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: Amazon S3 is the cloud storage provider used for file management.

architectural_units.name: Payment Processing Service
architectural_units.description: External service used to handle payments and subscriptions.

architectural_units.name: Stripe
architectural_units.description: Stripe is the payment processing platform integrated into the system.

architectural_units.name: Analytics Service
architectural_units.description: External service used to track and analyze site traffic.

architectural_units.name: Google Analytics
architectural_units.description: Google Analytics is the tool used for tracking and analyzing traffic.

architectural_units.name: Error Monitoring Service
architectural_units.description: External service used to track and manage application errors.

architectural_units.name: Sentry
architectural_units.description: Sentry is the tool used for error tracking and management.

architectural_units.name: Email Service
architectural_units.description: External service used to create, send, and schedule emails.

architectural_units.name: Brevo
architectural_units.description: Brevo is the email service provider used for communications.

architectural_units.name: React
architectural_units.description: React is a JavaScript library used for building user interfaces.

architectural_units.name: TypeScript
architectural_units.description: TypeScript is the programming language used for the system implementation.

Security Service (Traefik) functions as a reverse proxy and load balancer, managing HTTP and HTTPS request routing. [...] Traefik enruta las solicitudes hacia el System Service (Next.js) basado en reglas de enrutamiento configuradas en el archivo docker-compose.yml.
System Service (Next.js) [...] Se comunica con el servicio de base de datos PostgreSQL (Data Service) utilizando Prisma como ORM.
System Service (Next.js) [...] Interactúa con varios servicios externos para funcionalidades específicas: Autenticación: Utiliza Google para la autenticación de usuarios.
System Service (Next.js) [...] Interactúa con varios servicios externos para funcionalidades específicas: Almacenamiento en la nube: Utiliza Amazon S3 para almacenar y recuperar archivos.
System Service (Next.js) [...] Interactúa con varios servicios externos para funcionalidades específicas: Procesamiento de pagos: Integra con Stripe para manejar pagos y suscripciones.
System Service (Next.js) [...] Interactúa con varios servicios externos para funcionalidades específicas: Análisis: Implementa Google Analytics para rastrear y analizar el tráfico del sitio.
System Service (Next.js) [...] Interactúa con varios servicios externos para funcionalidades específicas: Monitoreo de errores: Utiliza Sentry para rastrear y gestionar errores en la aplicación.
System Service (Next.js) [...] Correo Electrónico: Se conecta a Brevo para crear, enviar y programar correos electrónicos.

patterns.name: Component-Based
patterns.description: The Component-Based pattern focuses on building the user interface by creating independent and reusable components.

patterns.name: Observer Pattern
patterns.description: The Observer pattern establishes a one-to-many relationship between objects, where a subject maintains a list of observers to notify them of state changes.

patterns.name: Singleton Pattern
patterns.description: The Singleton pattern ensures that a class has only one instance and provides a global access point to that instance.
